The Bidder should submit a valid authorisation for body building after-sales & service support from t he OEM in favour of the Corporation with issuing details. 7. Bidder or its Oem should have ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management System), ISO 14001:2015 (Environ ment Management System) ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health & Safety Management System) certificat ion by IAF Approved bodies. 8. The equipment offered shall be with a Minimum local content of 50% (Class-I) as per Government o rder No. P- 45021/2/2017-PP dated 16.09.2020. The Bidders shall upload component-wise documentary evi dence forlocal content of a minimum of 50% (manufactured within India) under MAKE IN INDIA by self- cert ification/undertaking that the equipment offered meets the required local content 9. Availability of spare parts of the vehicles/machinery, including spare parts of the Hydraulic and pneumat ic systems & other critical components, must be assured for a minimum of 05 years. Undertaking in this re gard must be submitted by the oem along with the bid. 10. The warranty period of the supplied products shall start from the date of final acceptance of goods or a fter completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply) at the consignee location, OEM warranty certificates must be submitted by successful bidder at the time of delivery of goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any breakdown during t he warranty period. The Oem should have a well-established installation, commissioning training troublesh ooting and maintenance service group in U.P. for attending at after-sales services Address proof to be encl osed. 11. Data sheets of the products & Vehicle catalogue offered chassis in the bid are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the data sheet with the product specifications offered. In caseof any unexplained mismatched technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 12. The bidder?s offer is liable to be rejected if they don?t upload any of the certificates/documents in t he bid documents (ARAI of the offered Chassis, Test Certificates & authorization of critical components whi ch will be used in manufacturing of machine like Hoses,Hydraulic Cylinder, PTO/Powerpack , Material of co nstruction, Hyd pumps (To be Submitted by Bidder or Oem). 13. Net Worth Certificate by the CA of the bidder or its Oem.

14. Latest 3 Financial year CA certified turnover certificate with UDIN Number & ITR Copies. 15. The Bidder or its Oem must submit a Character certificate from the Commissionerate/DM. 16. The Bidder/Oem must have certification in Quality Requirement for Fusion Welding of Metallic \u000 A Materials, Risk Management System, Energy Management System, Zed Certification. 17. The bidder should accept all terms and conditions on Rs.100/- affidavit. 18. The OEM must submit a Solvency Certificate. 19. GA Drawing of the offered product to be Submitted. 20. NSIC Certificate of the bidding product is to be submitted by the bidder or its Oem. 21. The bidder or its OEM must submit Factory License, ESIC & PF Certificate. 22. The Oem must have registered Trade mark certificate. 23. The Bidder or its Oem must have ISO 16732:2012, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, IEC 60204-1:2016, ROHS & ISO of Steel Structure Fabrication, WACINDIA, GMP System, ISO of Customer satisfaction, DIN EN 10204:20 05 .
